content: $\bullet $ Content Selection (CS) measures how well the generated document matches the gold document in terms of mentioned records. We measure the precision and recall (denoted respectively CS-P% and CS-R%) of unique relations $r$ extracted from $\hat{y}_{1:T}$ that are also extracted from $y_{1:T}$.
